description: This file appears to be a PHP web page related to configuring MoCA network settings on a gateway device. It includes PHP code for server-side logic, HTML for structure, embedded JavaScript for dynamic interactions, and CSS for styling. The code retrieves current configuration values, provides UI elements for enabling/disabling MoCA, channel selection, privacy options, and other settings, and submits configuration changes via AJAX.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: JavaScript function to gather form data, perform validation, and send AJAX request to apply MoCA configuration changes.
